rationale: Record that release-cli.yml now pins core.autocrlf=false and core.eol=lf before the build-cli checkout. Git for Windows rewrites LF to CRLF on checkout, so the release archive verifier failed the pinned gpu-recipes.yaml catalog digest on both Windows legs of v0.832.0 while Linux passed on the same commit, and the all-platform build-cli gate blocked publishing. This makes a Windows release archive byte-identical to a Linux one; it changes only the line endings of packaged text files and adds no product, asset, or catalog content. No implementation authority is transferred and the accepted Vellum expansion boundary is unchanged.
